chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
He said: He was asked about the dripping of urine. He said: “He should place a pouch when he performs salat (prayer).”

key_terms.خَرِيطَةً: a pouch or bag used to contain the leakage

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if urine drips during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one afflicted by dripping urine during salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام instructs such a person to use a pouch, indicating a practical measure related to ritual purity and the performance of prayer.
